components.name: generic-extraction
components.scope: Direct HTTP media and uncompressed UTF-8/ASCII HTML5 pages with audio/video elements, typed progressive HTTP sources, explicit zero-based source-ID selection per entry, and fully extracted playlists for multiple elements; optional positive source width/height/res attributes and bounded resolution-based default/best/worst ranking; no embedded players, full upstream ranking, nested/site playlists or manifests

components.name: extractor-contract
components.scope: Small typed video info and progressive VideoFormat subset, ExtractResult video/PlaylistInfo variants for fully extracted HTML5 entries, literal-ID and bounded resolution-based default/best/worst selection, ordered extractor registry, shared direct response inspection, opt-in whole-extraction retries with bounded Retry-After delay-seconds/preferred HTTP-date; no nested playlists or unresolved URL results; bounded audio/video selectors, two-stream + pairs and / fallbacks with explicit native ranking policy

components.name: http-downloader
components.scope: Streaming whole-file transfers, page referrers for HTML5 media, no-clobber publication, bounded download retries for selected transient HTTP statuses and connection/body failures, in-invocation range resume guarded by strong ETags, known lengths and response validation; shared transient HTTP classification/backoff with extraction; bounded Retry-After delay-seconds/preferred HTTP-date shared with extraction; byte-progress observers and cooperative cancellation checkpoints including retry-wait polling; no persistent resume, Last-Modified validators or obsolete HTTP-date Retry-After formats

components.name: orchestration-and-output
components.scope: Multiple URLs, simulate, per-video NDJSON, sequential HTML5 playlist entry downloads with failure continuation, basic output templates, literal HTML5 source-ID or bounded resolution-based default/best/worst selection applied independently to each entry, bounded --retries download option with guarded range recovery and independent opt-in --extractor-retries whole-extraction budget with bounded Retry-After delay-seconds/preferred HTTP-date; throttled CLI download byte progress on stderr; no CLI cancellation/signal handling or general option parity; bounded audio/video selectors, two-stream + pairs and / fallbacks with explicit native ranking policy

components.name: youtube
components.scope: Strict single-video URL dispatch and bounded watch-page/player response parsing; playable matching ID, direct standalone or separate MP4/M4A/WebM formats with numeric itags and dimensions, media probes and resolution/itag selection; missing initial response permits one isolated anonymous WEB API request using literal page client config, API formats limited to token-exempt itag 18; saved-fixture parser/token policy comparison only, no live-site reliability claim; opt-in progressive signatureCipher/legacy cipher and query-n solving with lazy explicit pinned-Deno configuration after eligibility/token filtering and before probes; actual saved-player upstream EJS signature-permutation metadata comparison; direct adaptive stream-kind and declared bitrate metadata with bounded selection and explicit FFmpeg merging; no other API clients, token acquisition, authentication, live, fragmented adaptive delivery, manifests, SABR or playlists

components.name: youtube-challenge-runtime
components.scope: Private offline EJS 0.8.0 assets/protocol and bounded explicit-path Deno 2.9.7 runner, exact saved-player n/signature vectors, strict complete JSON validation and process/pipe budgets; canonical-origin bounded player discovery/acquisition with validated redirects and pure progressive n/signature URL rewriting, saved-player-to-media private pipeline; prerequisite runtime CI matrix passed on Linux/macOS/Windows; opt-in signature/query-n extraction with explicit lazy runtime configuration; no other runtimes, caches or live-site support

components.name: direct-stream-merging
components.scope: Explicit executable local two-input stream-copy merging, MP4/M4A to MP4, WebM to WebM and mixed to Matroska, bounded process/pipe execution, cancellation and no-clobber publication; no discovery, installation, transcoding, multistream, fixups or other postprocessing
